caption: What if you were a bat for a day? You would be the only mammal that can truly fly, and your wings would be skin stretched over long finger bones. Bedtime is upside down: your body weight locks your claws shut, so hanging takes almost no energy. To hunt in the dark you shout, and the echoes are too high-pitched for humans to hear. And no, bats are not blind: all of them can see. One bat can eat thousands of insects in a single night. India has about 135 bat species, and the Indian flying fox has wings up to 1.5 m wide. Fruit bats spread the seeds of mango, guava and fig trees. This Halloween week, remember: of 1,400+ bat species, only 3 drink blood, and all three live in Latin America. Plot twist: India's 'greater false vampire bat' hunts insects, fish and lizards but never drinks blood. Bats are our friends, but never touch a wild bat. Would YOU swap with a bat for one night? 👇
